rules: Detour = blocked road, construction or waterlogging forcing longer route, about +35% distance plus refusal premium
Regular holiday = normal weekends/govt holidays, lower demand
Festive holiday = Eid, Pohela Boishakh, Durga Puja, Victory Day, medium-high
Student = 50% off bus only, min Tk 10
Metro = official fare matrix; unaffected by weather/blockage
Non-metro prices are estimates for planning/demo, not official tariffs
